qs.ours: Tertullian (de Corona.) argues from this verse in favour of the exercise of reason and the right of private judgment, in religious matters: "An non putas omni fideli licere, concipere et constituere dumtazat quod Deo congruat, quod disciplinae conducat, quod saluti proficiat, dicente Domino, Cur autem non et a vobis-ipsis quod judtum judicatis?'^
